title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Note Terms Schedule: Prepayment Fee, Free Prepayment, Re-amortization and Payoff Quotes
content:
Under the note terms of Equipment & Vehicle Loans, principal may be prepaid; this schedule states, product by product, the prepayment fee schedule and the threshold at which it applies, the free prepayment allowance, the re-amortization terms and how long a payoff quote remains good.

## Prepayment fee schedule (fixed-rate loans at or above the threshold)

| Product | Prepayment fee by loan year | Original principal at or above which the schedule applies (USD) | Free prepayment per loan year (% of original principal) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | none (empty schedule) | 0 (not applicable) | 100 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | none (empty schedule) | 0 (not applicable) | 100 |
| Used Equipment Loan | none (empty schedule) | 0 (not applicable) | 100 |
| New Equipment Loan | loan years 1 to 2: 2.0 %; loan years 3 to 4: 1.0 %; none after loan year 4 | 250000 | 20 |
| Irrigation System Loan | loan years 1 to 3: 2.0 %; loan years 4 to 6: 1.0 %; none after loan year 6 | 250000 | 20 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | loan years 1 to 3: 2.0 %; loan years 4 to 7: 1.0 %; none after loan year 7 | 250000 | 20 |

## Re-amortization and payoff quotes

| Product | Smallest cumulative curtailment before re-amortization may be asked (USD) | Re-amortization fee (USD) | Days a payoff quote remains good (quote date is day 0) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | 0 (not offered) | 0 | 10 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | 0 (not offered) | 0 | 10 |
| Used Equipment Loan | 10000 | 100 | 10 |
| New Equipment Loan | 25000 | 150 | 10 |
| Irrigation System Loan | 25000 | 200 | 15 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | 50000 | 250 | 15 |

## Definitions

- **Prepayment fee schedule** — the prepayment fee on fixed-rate loans at or above the prepayment threshold, by loan year (the year counted from the funding date): the fee percentage of the first entry whose last loan year is at least the current loan year; no fee after the last entry; an empty schedule means never.
- **Prepayment threshold** — the original principal at or above which a fixed-rate loan carries the prepayment fee schedule; 0 means not applicable.
- **Free prepayment** — voluntary prepayments up to this percentage of original principal per loan year carry no prepayment fee.
- **Re-amortization minimum** — the smallest cumulative prepayment or release paydown since funding or the last re-amortization after which the member may ask to re-amortize; 0 means re-amortization is not offered.
- **Re-amortization fee** — the fee per re-amortization, USD.
- **Payoff quote validity** — the calendar days a payoff quote remains good, the quote date being day 0.

## Reading the schedule

- Hypothetical: on a fixed-rate New Equipment Loan of 300000 original principal, a prepayment in loan year 3 falls in the entry for loan years 3 to 4, at 1.0 %; in loan year 5 no fee applies, the schedule having ended.
- Hypothetical: on a fixed-rate Grain Storage & Handling Loan, loan year 5 falls in the entry for loan years 4 to 7, at 1.0 %.
- A payoff quote dated on day 0 on a Truck & Trailer Loan is good through day 10; on an Irrigation System Loan through day 15.
